prompts.name: brick-mortar
prompts.prompt: Original 2:1 landscape GAME MATERIAL ATLAS. Exactly two equal square panels touching at centre. Flat orthographic BASE COLOUR only, even diffuse light, no cast shadows, labels, text, borders or objects. LEFT: uninterrupted surface of old hand-made, coal-fired red brick. Deep muted brown-red body with clinker inclusions, small open pits, sand grains, subtle hand-moulded ripples and irregular firing variation. No bricks, grid, mortar joints or perspective: this square is the surface of ONE brick to map onto existing individual brick meshes. Not quarry floor tile or smooth ceramic. RIGHT: uninterrupted old lime mortar, muted grey buff, fine gritty sand aggregate, small pale grains, friable recessed areas and a few tiny pores. Dry matt, no brick pattern, no large cracks or mould. Historic working Black Country buildings, cared-for but heavily used. Keep material colour variation restrained and natural, with rich fine detail. Both halves should tile visually, no dark edges.
